translationRepairs: Examining official Sima Guang ranked it third class; Fan Zhen found it difficult.
Examining official Sima Guang ranked it third class; Fan Zhen objected to that ranking.

難之 here is Fan Zhen's objection to Sima Guang's third-class ranking, not that Fan Zhen found the essay intellectually difficult; the replacement matches the Chinese and the surrounding examiner debate.
A year later he buried his father and entered mourning.
A year later he entered mourning for his father.
丁父憂 records entering mourning for his father; the original idiomatic English invents a burial the Chinese does not state, and the replacement is complete and accurate.
Wang Anshi was then chancellor, jointly overseeing the Three Bureaus reforms with Chen Shengzhi, and Zhe was appointed to his staff.
Wang Anshi was then a chief councilor, jointly overseeing the Three Bureaus Regulations with Chen Shengzhi, and Zhe was appointed to their staff.
執政 is a chief councilor, not specifically chancellor; 領三司條例 names the Regulations commission, and 為之屬 makes Zhe staff to both overseers, so the replacement corrects office, agency, and title.

It happened that Wang Guanglian, transport commissioner of Hebei, memorialized begging to count several thousand monk certificates as capital, and at the Shaanxi Commissariat bureau privately to practice the Green Sprouts law—disbursing in spring and collecting in autumn—which matched Anshi's intent; thereupon the Green Sprouts law was then put into practice.

It happened that Wang Guanglian, transport judge of Hebei, memorialized begging to count several thousand monk certificates as capital, and at the Shaanxi Commissariat bureau privately to practice the Green Sprouts law—disbursing in spring and collecting in autumn—which matched Anshi's intent; thereupon the Green Sprouts law was then put into practice.
轉運判官 is the transport judge, distinct from 轉運使 (transport commissioner); the replacement restores the correct office without other change.
Three years after that he was promoted to Assistant Gentlemen for Drafting.
Three years after that he was promoted to Assistant Editorial Director.
著作佐郎 is Assistant Editorial Director of the historiography office, not a gentlemen-for-drafting post; the replacement restores the office name.
After another three years he was changed to Assistant Gentlemen for Drafting.
After another three years he was changed to Assistant Editorial Director.
The literal field makes the same office error; Assistant Editorial Director is the accurate rendering of 著作佐郎.
Two years later, when his brother Shi offended in verse, he was demoted to supervisor of the Jizhou salt and wine tax and went five years without reassignment.
Two years later, when his brother Shi offended in verse, he was demoted to supervisor of the Yunzhou salt and wine tax and went five years without reassignment.
筠州 is Yunzhou; Jizhou would be 吉州, so the original place-name is a factual error and Yunzhou is the correct restoration.
After two years, because his elder brother Shi offended in a poem he was demoted to supervisor of the Jizhou salt and wine tax; for five years he received no transfer.
After two years, because his elder brother Shi offended in a poem he was demoted to supervisor of the Yunzhou salt and wine tax; for five years he received no transfer.
The literal field likewise misreads 筠州 as Jizhou; replacing it with Yunzhou restores the place named in the Chinese.
Earlier, when Xi Xia fell into civil strife Shenzong had campaigned in force, adding Lanzhou on the Xi River frontier and Anjiang, Mizhi, and five other forts around Yan'an.
Earlier, when Xi Xia fell into civil strife Shenzong had campaigned in force, adding Lanzhou on the Xihe frontier and five forts around Yan'an, including Anjiang and Mizhi.
熙河 is the Xihe circuit, not the Xi River, and 等五砦 is a set of five forts including Anjiang and Mizhi, not five additional forts; the proposed 'the rest of five forts' is still awkward English.
Gong Zhu saw the point but could not carry the policy.
Gong Zhu understood, but in the end the advice was not adopted.
公著悟，竟未能用 means Gongzhu understood but the advice was not in the end adopted; the original makes him the failed executor of a policy he controlled.

I therefore ask a clear edict: abolish the external water supervising assistant; return Hebei river work and every circuit's Chief Works Court to transport commissioners; and place the three directorates under the Revenue Ministry as well, to decide whether projects are warranted and how much they cost, while Works judges quality of labor and pace of construction.

I therefore ask a clear edict: abolish the external water supervising assistant; return Hebei river work and every circuit's Chief Works Court to transport commissioners; and place the three directorates under the Revenue Ministry as well, to decide whether projects are warranted and how much they cost, while the Ministry of Works judges quality of labor and pace of construction.
工部 is the Ministry of Works; a bare 'Works' drops the institution named in the Chinese and leaves the agent unclear, while the replacement restores it.
" I recently argued in audience that gentlemen and petty men cannot serve together, and Your Majesty did not seem to reject me.
"I recently argued in audience that gentlemen and petty men cannot serve together, and Your Majesty did not seem to reject me.
The opening quotation in the Chinese has no extra space; the stray space after the English quotation mark is a real defect and the replacement is otherwise unchanged.
The court though knew it was wrong, in the end did not clearly understand how to dispose; if this then nourishes frontier quarrel, can Guan and Shaan again dwell in peace?
The court though knew it was wrong, in the end did not clearly dispose of the matter; if this then nourishes frontier quarrel, can Guan and Shaan again dwell in peace?
明白處置 means to dispose of the matter clearly, not a failure to understand how to dispose; the replacement restores that sense.
In the sixth year he was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat and promoted to Vice Minister of the Gate.
In the sixth year he was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and promoted to Vice Director of the Chancellery.

門下侍郎 is Vice Director of the Chancellery, not Minister of the Gate, but 尚書右丞 is Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, not of the Secretariat; the proposal leaves that second office wrong.
In the sixth year he was appointed Right Vice Director of the Secretariat and advanced to Vice Minister of the Gate.
In the sixth year he was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and advanced to Vice Director of the Chancellery.
The literal field has the same pair of offices: 門下侍郎 is correctly restored as Chancellery vice director, but 尚書右丞 must also be the Department of State Affairs, not the Secretariat.
Zhe said, "A hundred thousand Xi Xia horsemen press Xihe, yet kill and dig only at the disputed cliffs—their intent is plain. This is not Xi Xia's fault but the court's injustice.
Zhe memorialized: "A hundred thousand Xi Xia horsemen press Xihe, yet kill and dig only at the disputed cliffs—their intent is plain. This is not Xi Xia's fault but the court's injustice.
轍奏曰 marks a memorial, which the adjacent 劉摯曰 does not; reducing it to unmarked 'said' drops that register, and 'memorialized' restores it without other change.
Early in Shaosheng, Zhezong raised Li Qingchen to Secretariat Drafter and Deng Runfu to Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
Early in Shaosheng, Zhezong raised Li Qingchen to Secretariat Drafter and Deng Runfu to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
尚書左丞 belongs to the Shangshu (Department of State Affairs), while 中書舍人 is the Secretariat office in the same sentence; the original conflates the two.
At the beginning of Shaosheng Zhezong raised Li Qingchen to Secretariat Drafter and Deng Runfu to Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
At the beginning of Shaosheng Zhezong raised Li Qingchen to Secretariat Drafter and Deng Runfu to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
The literal field makes the same 尚書左丞 error; Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs matches the Chinese office.
Emperor Zhezong read the memorial and, thinking it compared the former dynasty to Han Wudi, was displeased.
Emperor Zhezong read the memorial and, thinking it compared the late emperor to Han Wudi, was displeased.
先朝 here is the late emperor's court (Shenzong), the object of the Han Wudi comparison, not a former dynasty; the replacement aligns with that sense.
Before he arrived, he was reduced to Grand Master for Discussion and acting Supervisor of the Palace Storehouse, assigned to serve Nanjing in a divisional post and reside in Jizhou.
Before he arrived, he was reduced to Grand Master for Discussion and acting Supervisor of the Palace Storehouse, assigned to serve Nanjing in a divisional post and reside in Yunzhou.
筠州居住 assigns residence at Yunzhou; Jizhou would be 吉州 and is a false place-name.
Tao could use none of it and in the end suffered offense.
Tao used none of it, and in the end Yuanlao was punished.
竟得罪 continues Yuanlao's biography after Zhou Tao rejected the plan; the next sentence's later commander following 元老策 confirms Yuanlao, not Tao, is the one who incurred punishment.
when deliberating returning the river and hired service, he differed and agreed with Wen Yanbo and Sima Guang;
when deliberating returning the river and hired service, he had disagreements with Wen Yanbo and Sima Guang;
與……異同 here means disagreement, as the next sentence's 又……不合 confirms; 'differed and agreed' invents simultaneous agreement the Chinese does not state.
